messages:
jess (PM): 5-min sync: need a customer-facing GA checklist for long-term routing, multi-region, tenant isolation. Sales wants something we can point to in early SOWs.
omar (Eng-Arch): high-level proposal: 3 service profiles: compliance (region-locked), resilient (regional failover), and economical (pooled compute). each profile => placement model + routing policy + expected SLO envelope.
viktor (Infra): compliance implies enforced placement metadata + audit events + per-tenant egress controls. resilient needs warm standby + automated failover hooks. economical needs batching + permissive quantization. reserved capacity required for compliance pilots.
mei (Sales): customers ask for: explicit p95 commitments, a residency addendum, and a visible cost delta in quotes. big asks from MediGuard (health) and BankDelta (finance). they want a 60-90 day pilot with migration support.
jess (PM): concise GA checklist draft: 1) residency enforcement tests passing; 2) end-to-end SLO verification (p95 + availability); 3) two pilots with stable cutover (14d); 4) billing reconciliation within 5%; 5) cutover runbook + rollback steps.
omar (Eng-Arch): suggested targets: compliance p95 <= 220ms in-region, resilient p95 <= 180ms (failover documented), economical p95 <= 300ms but aim for 30-50% token cost reduction vs resilient. GA availability >= 99.95 for paid profiles.
viktor (Infra): test harness items: multi-region traffic replay, tenant eviction/noisy-neighbor fuzz tests, billing-tag reconciliation. rough ETA: compliance infra + audit sink = 4 sprints, resilient plumbing = 2 sprints, economical tuning = 3 sprints.
mei (Sales): add to checklist: residency addendum drafted and legal looped, Console preview of cost/latency tradeoff, pilot pack with runbook + support SLA. customers won't sign without the preview.
jess (PM): migration story: incremental cutover via shadowing/mirroring for 7-14 days, metrics comparison, DNS cutover, and rollback window. metric gate: cutover latency delta and error budget burn within thresholds.
omar (Eng-Arch): product knobs: expose profile in Console + API. minimal policy schema: {"profile":"compliance|resilient|economical","region_pin":"<region|null>","failover":"auto|manual"} store derived routing keys for hot-path lookups.
viktor (Infra): implementation note: avoid per-request JSON parse; keep derived columns for routing decision and a small cache for tenant policies. will prototype placement enforcement next week.
legal-bot: reminder: add residency clause RESID-1 to pilot contracts and attach to the pilot pack repo.
mei (Sales): timeline ask: can we start pilots in Q2? need two anchor customers and a QA runbook.
jess (PM): prioritization: A) residency enforcement + audit logs, B) Console policy editor + preview, C) reserved SKU + pricing model, D) economy cost optimizations. gate GA on the checklist above.
omar (Eng-Arch): escape hatch: per-tenant override to force-fallback during incidents; must be auditable.
viktor (Infra): will draft reserved SKU worksheet and infra ETA by Tue.
mei (Sales): i'll confirm anchors (MediGuard, BankDelta) and legal contacts.
jess (PM): action items: omar -> architecture spec + acceptance tests (EOW). viktor -> infra ETA + SKU (Tue). mei -> anchor pilots + legal contacts (Mon). i'll assemble the pilot pack and GA checklist.
mei (Sales): ack. thanks all. :rocket:
